typography.guidelines: Do not use Inter for headings. Use Outfit with tight tracking (tracking-tight) for large headers to establish a premium SaaS aesthetic. Use Inter strictly for data tables, side panels, and body text for extreme legibility.

layouts.dashboard_grid: Bento Grid Protocol (Mode B). High-density, high-scannability. Use grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-6. Make main charts (Grade Trends, Study Consistency) span 2 or 3 columns.
layouts.sidebar: Left fixed sidebar, min-w-[260px], border-r (light: border-slate-200, dark: border-slate-800). Must contain Logo (graduation cap), Nav Items (Dashboard, Study Center, AI Assistant, Analytics, Teacher Portal, Settings), 'Upload Content' button, Help Center & Logout at bottom.
layouts.pdf_ai_split: Use a robust CSS grid split-pane layout (60% PDF viewer / Video Player, 40% AI Assistant panel). The AI panel must utilize glassmorphism to look floating/integrated.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy: use p-6 to p-8 inside cards to prevent text collision and maintain breathing room.

surfaces.cards: Subtle border + flat background. Dark mode: border-[#334155] bg-[#1E293B]. Light mode: border-[#E2E8F0] bg-white. Radius: rounded-xl.
surfaces.glassmorphism: For AI Tutor panels, sticky headers, and modals: use high-quality optical glass. Light mode: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/70 border-white/40. Dark mode: backdrop-blur-xl bg-[#0A192F]/80 border-slate-700/50. NO pure transparent backgrounds.
surfaces.shadows: Light mode: shadow-sm for structural cards, shadow-xl for floating dropdowns/modals. Dark mode: rely heavily on 1px inner borders and localized radial glows instead of large drop shadows.

motion.hover_states: -translate-y-0.5 with subtle shadow elevation. Interactive cards must transition smoothly. Buttons use scale-95 on active. All interactive elements must have transition-colors and transition-transform.
motion.page_transitions: Utilize framer-motion fade + slight slide-up (y: 10 to y: 0) for dashboard widgets with staggered entrances.

components.buttons: Rounded-lg. Primary button: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white shadow-[0_0_15px_rgba(37,99,235,0.4)] (glow effect).
components.charts: Use Recharts (BarCharts for Consistency, LineCharts for Trends). Ensure axis text and tooltips adapt perfectly to the surface_glass aesthetics in both light and dark modes.
components.ai_chat: Chat bubbles: AI = surface color with subtle brand border, User = primary brand color. Quick action chips below input (solve math, explain concept, study plan).
components.gamification: Level progress rings using circular SVG strokes. Badges with rich colors and drop-shadows.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure text meets APCA standards. All non-text interactive elements need clear focus rings (focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-500 focus:outline-none).
accessibility.testing_ids: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include data-testid attributes (e.g., data-testid='sidebar-nav-dashboard', data-testid='ai-tutor-submit').

visual_enhancers.gradients: Avoid generic full-page gradients. Use localized radial glows (e.g., a faint blue/green radial gradient behind the Gamification badge or XP stats) to create depth.

student_studying.description: Student at laptop, ideal for hero sections, 'Continue Learning' banners, or onboarding screens.

teacher_avatar.description: Smiling female teacher portrait, for use in the Teacher Portal or instructor profiles.

math_abstract.description: Abstract math geometry, useful as a fallback course cover or subject banner (especially for Math/Physics).

graduation_cap.description: Graduation cap image for Gamification modules, level-up modals, or achievement milestone cards.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build the dashboard using React, Tailwind CSS, and Shadcn UI primitives.
Implement a robust layout with a collapsible sidebar and a top sticky header containing the Light/Dark mode toggle.
Ensure seamless toggling between Light and Dark mode using Tailwind's 'dark:' variant class strategy.
Do NOT use raw HTML input date or select. Use Shadcn Popover/Calendar and Select components.
Use Recharts for rendering Performance Analytics (grade trends, focus areas, study hours).
For the PDF Reader/AI Split view and Video Player, ensure the AI Tutor panel uses premium glassmorphism effects alongside the content viewer.
Inject the E1 spacing philosophy: generous paddings (p-6 to p-8) inside dashboard cards.
Ensure 'Inter' is imported for body/ui text, and 'Outfit' is imported for headings via Google Fonts or standard imports.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Do not converge toward generic outputs. Create depth through layered z-index hierarchy and glassmorphism.
Never apply `transition: all`. Target specific properties like `transition-colors` or `transition-transform` to prevent layout breaks.
Never center align the main `.App` container. Maintain natural left-aligned reading flow.
Always use modern button styles with interaction animations and explicit active/focus states.
Never use generic AI emojis for icons. Use `lucide-react` exclusively for a professional SaaS look.
Every interaction needs micro-animations (hover states, focus rings). Static = dead.
Provide `data-testid` on all interactive UI components for testing.
All headers/overlays must use blur filters or solid backgrounds; never leave them completely transparent if content scrolls beneath.
